import urllib.request
import re
import json
from html.parser import HTMLParser

class TagParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.tags = []
        self.classes = set()
        self.data_attrs = set()
        self.ids = set()
        self.roles = set()
        self.links = []
        self.in_script = False
        self.in_title = False
        self.in_h1 = False
        self.in_h2 = False
        self.current_text = []
        self.title = ""
        self.h1s = []
        self.h2s = []
        self.scripts = []
        self.metas = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attr_dict = dict(attrs)
        self.tags.append((tag, attr_dict))
        
        if tag == "title":
            self.in_title = True
        elif tag == "h1":
            self.in_h1 = True
            self.current_text = []
        elif tag == "h2":
            self.in_h2 = True
            self.current_text = []
        elif tag == "script":
            self.in_script = True
            if "src" in attr_dict:
                self.scripts.append(attr_dict["src"])
        elif tag == "meta":
            self.metas.append(attr_dict)
        elif tag == "a" and "href" in attr_dict:
            self.links.append((attr_dict.get("href", ""), attr_dict.get("class", "")))

        if "class" in attr_dict:
            for c in attr_dict["class"].split():
                self.classes.add(c)
        if "id" in attr_dict:
            self.ids.add(attr_dict["id"])
        if "role" in attr_dict:
            self.roles.add(attr_dict["role"])
            
        for k in attr_dict:
            if k.startswith("data-"):
                self.data_attrs.add(k)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == "title":
            self.in_title = False
        elif tag == "h1":
            self.in_h1 = False
            self.h1s.append(" ".join(self.current_text).strip())
            self.current_text = []
        elif tag == "h2":
            self.in_h2 = False
            self.h2s.append(" ".join(self.current_text).strip())
            self.current_text = []
        elif tag == "script":
            self.in_script = False

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.in_title:
            self.title += data.strip()
        elif self.in_h1 or self.in_h2:
            self.current_text.append(data.strip())

snapshots = [
    ("Oct 2022", "20221022213729", "https://web.archive.org/web/20221022213729/https://www.pendo.io/"),
    ("Feb 2023", "20230209114429", "https://web.archive.org/web/20230209114429/https://www.pendo.io/"),
    ("Jun 2023", "20230617214543", "https://web.archive.org/web/20230617214543/https://www.pendo.io/")
]

summary = {}

for period, ts, url in snapshots:
    print(f"Fetching {period} ({url})...")
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp:
            html = resp.read().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
            parser = TagParser()
            parser.feed(html)
            
            # GTM / scripts extraction
            gtm_scripts = [s for s in parser.scripts if "googletagmanager" in s or "gtm" in s]
            all_ext_scripts = [s for s in parser.scripts if not "archive.org" in s]
            
            # Extract meta tags
            desc = ""
            canonical = ""
            for m in parser.metas:
                if m.get("name") == "description":
                    desc = m.get("content", "")
            
            canon_match = re.search(r'<link[^>]+rel=["\']canonical["\'][^>]+href=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', html, re.I)
            if canon_match:
                canonical = canon_match.group(1)
                
            # Filter component classes
            comp_classes = [c for c in parser.classes if any(k in c.lower() for k in ['component', 'block', 'hero', 'card', 'slider', 'tab', 'accordion', 'banner', 'grid', 'modal', 'feature', 'quote', 'logo', 'marquee', 'stat', 'btn', 'cta', 'nav', 'footer', 'menu', 'badge'])]
            
            # Filter data attributes
            data_attrs = list(parser.data_attrs)
            
            summary[period] = {
                "title": parser.title,
                "description": desc,
                "canonical": canonical,
                "h1s": [h for h in parser.h1s if h],
                "h2s": [h for h in parser.h2s if h][:8],
                "external_scripts": all_ext_scripts[:12],
                "gtm_scripts": gtm_scripts,
                "data_attributes": data_attrs,
                "roles": list(parser.roles),
                "component_classes": sorted(comp_classes)[:40],
                "ids": [i for i in parser.ids if any(k in i.lower() for k in ['nav', 'menu', 'header', 'footer', 'hero', 'modal', 'tab', 'component', 'block'])][:15]
            }
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error {period}: {e}")

print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
